name: Raster window extraction
description: Read a bounded pixel window and selected bands from an externally held tiled TIFF/BigTIFF source, selecting a concrete base or overview IFD.
preconditions: The source is a tiled TIFF or BigTIFF with a strong ETag for range-read consistency.
The source CRS is explicitly resolved by the supported GeoTIFF GeoKey resolver.
The requested window is expressed in pixel coordinates on the selected base or overview grid.
The selected source IFD and every requested tile are within configured directory, request, byte, tile, decode, and output budgets.
The selected bands exist in the source raster.
validation_requirements: The output byte length matches the declared window dimensions and selected sample dtypes.
The output window and selected bands match the normalized request.
The selected overview factor and IFD are recorded in immutable Run provenance.
The output grid transform and CRS are derived from the selected TIFF directory.
NoData validity is represented explicitly and is not inferred from pixel values alone.
